{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module LogAgent where

import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS8
import Data.Char (ord, isAscii)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forM_)

-- | Configuration for the logging agent
data LogConfig = LogConfig
  { lcEndpoint    :: T.Text
  , lcApiKey      :: T.Text
  , lcAllowedHosts :: [T.Text]
  , lcLogLevel    :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Normalize a hostname for comparison
-- Uses NFKC-like normalization to prevent homograph attacks
normalizeHostname :: T.Text -> T.Text
normalizeHostname host = 
  let lower = T.toLower host
      -- Strip any trailing dots (DNS root)
      stripped = T.dropWhileEnd (== '.') lower
      -- Normalize common confusable characters
      normalized = T.map replaceConfusable stripped
  in normalized

-- | Replace visually confusable Unicode characters with ASCII equivalents
replaceConfusable :: Char -> Char
replaceConfusable c
  | c == '\x0430' = 'a'  -- Cyrillic а -> Latin a
  | c == '\x0435' = 'e'  -- Cyrillic е -> Latin e
  | c == '\x043E' = 'o'  -- Cyrillic о -> Latin o
  | c == '\x0440' = 'p'  -- Cyrillic р -> Latin p
  | c == '\x0441' = 'c'  -- Cyrillic с -> Latin c
  | c == '\x0443' = 'y'  -- Cyrillic у -> Latin y
  | c == '\x0445' = 'x'  -- Cyrillic х -> Latin x
  | c == '\x0455' = 's'  -- Cyrillic ѕ -> Latin s
  | c == '\x0456' = 'i'  -- Cyrillic і -> Latin i
  | c == '\x0458' = 'j'  -- Cyrillic ј -> Latin j
  | c == '\x04BB' = 'h'  -- Cyrillic һ -> Latin h
  | c == '\xFF41' = 'a'  -- Fullwidth a
  | c == '\xFF45' = 'e'  -- Fullwidth e
  | c == '\xFF4F' = 'o'  -- Fullwidth o
  | otherwise     = c

-- | Check if a text contains only ASCII characters
isAsciiOnly :: T.Text -> Bool
isAsciiOnly = T.all isAscii

-- | Validate that a hostname is in the allowed list
-- Returns True if the host is permitted
-- SECURITY: Rejects any hostname containing non-ASCII characters
validateHost :: [T.Text] -> T.Text -> Bool
validateHost allowedHosts targetHost =
  let normalizedTarget = normalizeHostname targetHost
      normalizedAllowed = map normalizeHostname allowedHosts
  in isAsciiOnly targetHost && normalizedTarget `elem` normalizedAllowed

-- | Parse the endpoint URL and extract the hostname
extractHostname :: T.Text -> T.Text
extractHostname url =
  let withoutScheme = case T.stripPrefix "https://" url of
        Just rest -> rest
        Nothing   -> case T.stripPrefix "http://" url of
          Just rest -> rest
          Nothing   -> url
      hostPart = T.takeWhile (\c -> c /= '/' && c /= ':') withoutScheme
  in hostPart

-- | Load configuration from environment
loadConfig :: IO LogConfig
loadConfig = do
  endpoint <- lookupEnv "LOG_ENDPOINT"
  apiKey   <- lookupEnv "LOG_API_KEY"
  hosts    <- lookupEnv "LOG_ALLOWED_HOSTS"
  level    <- lookupEnv "LOG_LEVEL"
  let allowedHosts = case hosts of
        Just h  -> T.splitOn "," (T.pack h)
        Nothing -> ["logs.internal.example.com", "metrics.internal.example.com"]
  return LogConfig
    { lcEndpoint     = T.pack (fromMaybe "https://logs.internal.example.com/ingest" endpoint)
    , lcApiKey       = T.pack (fromMaybe "" apiKey)
    , lcAllowedHosts = allowedHosts
    , lcLogLevel     = read (fromMaybe "3" level)
    }

-- | Core dispatch function that sends log data to the configured endpoint
-- This performs validation before dispatching
dispatchLog :: LogConfig -> T.Text -> T.Text -> IO Bool
dispatchLog config logLevel message = do
  let endpoint = lcEndpoint config
      host = extractHostname endpoint
  -- Validate the endpoint host against allowed hosts
  if validateHost (lcAllowedHosts config) host
    then do
      -- In production this would be an HTTP POST
      putStrLn $ "[DISPATCH] Sending to: " ++ T.unpack endpoint
      putStrLn $ "[DISPATCH] Level: " ++ T.unpack logLevel
      putStrLn $ "[DISPATCH] Message: " ++ T.unpack message
      return True
    else do
      putStrLn $ "[BLOCKED] Host not in allowlist: " ++ T.unpack host
      return False

-- | Process a dynamic reconfiguration request
-- Allows updating the endpoint at runtime via a control channel
reconfigure :: IORef LogConfig -> T.Text -> IO Bool
reconfigure configRef newEndpoint = do
  config <- readIORef configRef
  let host = extractHostname newEndpoint
  -- Validate new endpoint against current allowed hosts
  -- Rejects non-ASCII hostnames to prevent homograph attacks
  if validateHost (lcAllowedHosts config) host
    then do
      let newConfig = config { lcEndpoint = newEndpoint }
      writeIORef configRef newConfig
      putStrLn $ "[RECONFIG] Endpoint updated to: " ++ T.unpack newEndpoint
      return True
    else do
      putStrLn $ "[RECONFIG DENIED] Invalid host: " ++ T.unpack host
      return False

-- | The main agent loop
agentMain :: IO ()
agentMain = do
  config <- loadConfig
  configRef <- newIORef config
  -- Simulate receiving log messages
  let messages = 
        [ ("INFO", "Application started")
        , ("WARN", "High memory usage detected")
        , ("ERROR", "Connection timeout to database")
        ]
  forM_ messages $ \(level, msg) -> do
    currentConfig <- readIORef configRef
    _ <- dispatchLog currentConfig level msg
    return ()
